review_notice: Draft for owner review. Nothing in this package is clinically approved, authorizes continuation or change of treatment, predicts relapse or hospitalization, or selects a product, dose, or taper. Do not activate.

source_classification.source_derived: Statements reproduced or conservatively constrained from the cited sources without adding a clinical threshold, without converting evidence grades or suggestion strengths into probabilities, and without converting a scale total, percent change, or course label into a continuation or change probability.
source_classification.proposed_for_review: Agent-proposed question, graph, states, transforms, baseline window, horizon, wording, and reference values; not source-derived clinical rules.
source_classification.drafting_lead: BN-04, BN-05, and BN-06 are incomplete, inference-disabled drafting leads, not approved mappings. Their deterministic workflow tables were replaced with soft argmax-preserving placeholders; no BN TABLE bytes, priors, or inference or deployment flags were copied.

question_enumeration.specific_question: For an adult follow-up encounter with a linked current baseline, given the current improvement course, tolerability burden (metabolic and other), patient preference barrier, adherence and exposure-change context, practical availability of the current agent, and urgent concern, what is the posterior distribution over continuation-discussion prompts (continuation discussion vs individualized change review), with parallel adherence, tolerability-exposure, and urgent-safety review prompts, to structure physician review?
question_enumeration.intended_setting: Adult outpatient follow-up for schizophrenia; current dated encounter with a chosen signed baseline. Not the emergency department. Local setting confirmation requested.
question_enumeration.proposed_time_horizon: Current encounter (no outcome prediction horizon). The baseline-to-current interval is recorded and displayed; no maximum recency interval is imposed in v0.1. The BN-05 12-month and BN-06 24-week outcome horizons are excluded by design.

output_meanings.OutsideScope: Contract-completeness branch only: estimated for all CPT rows but never reached when the gate holds (registration yields not_applicable and outdated linkage yields needs_clarification, both without inference). Not a continuation finding and not a change finding.
output_meanings.ContinuationDiscussion: Review prompt: improved and stable course with no assessed tolerability burden and the current agent available. Discuss ongoing treatment with surveillance and supports. Not a prescription, not a stability certification, not a relapse prediction.
output_meanings.IndividualizedChangeReview: Review prompt: residual burden, a tolerability concern, or a practical availability barrier is recorded. Review alternatives with benefit-harm balancing and gradual-change wording. Not a switch order, not a dose or taper order, not a product selection.
output_meanings.NotTriggered: Parallel prompt: no adherence or tolerability-exposure review is triggered; routine monitoring continues.
output_meanings.Triggered: Parallel prompt: an adherence-support or tolerability-exposure review is triggered; review barriers, supports, side effects, or exposure changes. Triggered never selects an LAI or orders a change.
output_meanings.routine_safety_assessment: Parallel prompt: no urgent concern is recorded; continue routine safety surveillance. Never a safety clearance.
output_meanings.urgent_clinician_assessment: Parallel prompt plus deterministic flag: a recorded urgent concern takes priority regardless of discussion status.

question_enumeration.applicability: Follow-up encounters only (encounter.kind == followup) with a linked current baseline (BaselineCurrency == linked_current). Registration yields not_applicable with reason; outdated, unreconciled, unknown, missing, or conflicting baseline linkage yields needs_clarification stopping later questions.

source_comparison.bn04_scope_vs_f6: BN-04 is a 32-node established-treatment review draft (response assessment, side-effect monitoring, four workflow flags, nine Table 6 drug-attribute lookups) with inference disabled. F6 reuses its review vocabulary (improvement course, preference barrier, adherence difficulty, significant side effects, urgent concern, monitoring as a standing item) but not its graph: the metadata-only proposed_parent entries (34, never edges) are not converted to edges, the Table 6 lookups are excluded (drug attributes, not patient risk), and dose, duration, and exposure-category nodes are excluded by FR-14 redesign.
source_comparison.bn05_scope_vs_f6: BN-05 is a 20-node maintenance-review draft after improvement (gate triad, adherence and exposure context, observed maintenance strategy, 12-month relapse and hospitalization outcomes, six workflow flags) with inference disabled. F6 reuses its gate shape (established diagnosis with documented improvement), its adherence, preference, exposure-change, and course context, and its parallel-review structure (guideline-context discussion plus adherence, tolerability-exposure, and urgent reviews). The observed strategy node is not estimated (observed, not decided), and the 12-month outcome nodes are excluded by design: F6 has a current-encounter horizon and predicts nothing.
source_comparison.bn06_scope_vs_f6: BN-06 is a 21-node same-agent continuation draft (scope triad, residual and tolerability reasons, preference, availability, LAI mismatch, discussion context, observed same-agent strategy, 24-week outcomes) with inference disabled and deployment disabled. F6 reuses its reason structure (residual burden, metabolic vs other tolerability, preference, availability) and its urgent-override shape. The observed strategy and 24-week outcome nodes are excluded by design. LAI mismatch is template context only; LAI product choice is outside F6. No BN-06 TABLE bytes, priors, or flags were copied.
source_comparison.overlap_resolution_one_network: The three drafts overlap on improvement course, side-effect and preference context, adherence, and urgent routing, but differ in scope (BN-04 review of treatment, BN-05 continuation of any antipsychotic, BN-06 continuation of the same agent) and in horizon (current review vs 12-month vs 24-week outcomes). F6 resolves the overlap into ONE 12-node network with one prompt and one question step: a single continuation-discussion output over improvement, tolerability, and availability; two parallel support outputs over adherence-preference and tolerability-exposure; one parallel urgent output; and course rendered as estimated context plus discussion wording. No runtime merge of three models occurs: the three deterministic workflow formalizations were replaced, outcome and strategy nodes were dropped, and horizons were unified to the current encounter.
source_comparison.cdss_restriction_resolution: BN-06 PROPERTY guideline_restriction and STATEMENT-06 Quality Measurement Considerations state that the 2B same-medication suggestion is not appropriate for electronic decision support or for use as a quality measure. Copying that draft into an executable network would not resolve the restriction. PROPOSED resolution for owner decision (Q1): F6 does not implement Statement 6 as decision support. It renders physician review prompts only, with no automated continue-or-switch recommendation (the posterior maximum is explicitly not a rule), no quality-measure output, no dose, taper, product, or schedule content, 2B strength never converted to a probability, and urgent routing via a deterministic flag read from saved inputs rather than from any model output. Activation additionally requires owner approval of this package and S39 bundle admission. If the owner rejects this framing, the fallback is to restrict F6 to Statements 4+5 content with Statement 6 retained as background context only, recorded as a package revision.
source_comparison.causal_interpretation_excluded: BN-05 declares treatment conditioning is not intervention and BN-06 declares observational hypotheses only. F6 honors both: estimated tables condition review-prompt distributions on observed context; no posterior is read as the effect of continuing, switching, tapering, or staying on a course. The template mapping rule forbids treatment-effect language, and all outcome and observed-strategy nodes are absent from the network so no such posterior can be produced.

graph_decision.why_this_shape: One discussion output over the three change drivers named across all three sources (course, tolerability, practicality), two parallel support outputs preserving BN-05's adherence and tolerability-exposure review structure, one parallel urgent output, and course estimated as context with discussion rendering. Monitoring is a standing template item (routine monitoring continues even when no review triggers), not a node, matching the BN-05 review-flag definitions. Effect-specific detail stays in F1-F4; F6 aggregates only their assessed constituents with no posterior chaining. All discrete nature nodes for the v1 execution profile; 141 cells within admission limits.
graph_decision.standalone_course_rationale: CourseContext has no child in v0.1: it is estimated as a root (all-CPT contract) and rendered as a discussion item (chronic course highlights destabilization risk when change is discussed), but conditions no output distribution. This mirrors the F5 treatment of its urgent root as estimated-plus-flagged context and keeps chronic-course language from altering probabilities without a reviewed effect model. Promoting course to a parent is a named v0.2 refinement for owner decision.
graph_decision.double_counting_rationale_for_review: Each assessed input is proposed as usage=both (CPT-estimation context + hard observation). Rationale for review: conditioning once in Bayes rule is a single update, not double counting; the LLM conditions table estimates on the patient's context while inference instantiates the same observed states as evidence. Optional missing inputs use estimation context only (the gap is noted in the conditioning context) with unknown_incomplete observed where declared, so no update occurs on an unassessed clinical fact. Baseline linkage is usage=cpt_context only (it gates execution and conditions estimation but is never a network node, so no observation exists). Owner to accept or restrict any mapping to observation-only.

reference_table_provenance.rule: Root references illustrative (ImprovementStatus [0.55,0.45]; CourseContext [0.35,0.40,0.25]; TolerabilityContext [0.45,0.15,0.25,0.15]; PreferenceBarrier [0.55,0.25,0.20]; AdherenceContext [0.60,0.20,0.20]; ExposureChangeContext [0.60,0.20,0.20]; PracticalAvailability [0.70,0.15,0.15]; UrgentSafetyConcern [0.92,0.08]). Continuation rows from the documented mapping: change-dominant [0.06,0.12,0.82] iff residual burden OR any tolerability concern OR access barrier (22 rows); continuation-dominant [0.06,0.82,0.12] for improved with none assessed and available or unknown availability (2 rows); OutsideScope held at 0.06 for contract completeness. Adherence rows: Triggered [0.12,0.88] iff adherence present OR preference present (4 of 9 rows); else NotTriggered [0.88,0.12]. Tolerability-exposure rows: Triggered [0.12,0.88] iff tolerability not none OR exposure present (9 of 12 rows); else NotTriggered [0.88,0.12]. Urgent: absent [0.90,0.10], present [0.10,0.90]. Lookup exists only to give the validator/inference harness complete, normalized, correctly ordered tables. Never present these as patient estimates.
reference_table_provenance.forbidden: No empirical probabilities were manufactured; no guideline recommendation strength (1A, 1B, 2B), evidence quality grade, PANSS total or band, percent change, course label, or posterior was converted into a probability, a continuation guarantee, a switch instruction, or a treatment-effect estimate.

unresolved_assumptions: All ten continue_review fields plus baseline_linkage are proposals; the history-effects package itself is still awaiting_review and the continue_review namespace is not collected, so no mapping used here is approved.
The CDSS-restriction resolution (Q1) is proposed, not decided; activation is blocked until the owner approves it or selects the Statements 4+5 fallback.
No maximum baseline recency interval is imposed; the interval is recorded for physician interpretation and any future cutoff needs review.
No percent-change value is computed and no cutoff is applied; PANSS totals are supporting context only.
No relapse, hospitalization, discontinuation, destabilization, or metabolic-trajectory outcome is estimated; the current-encounter horizon excludes the BN-05 12-month and BN-06 24-week horizons.
Conditioning on observed treatment or course context is review-prompt conditioning, not causal intervention evidence.
CourseContext as an estimated root with no child, monitoring as a standing template item, preference detail and LAI mismatch as template context, and both-usage (context+observation) all need review.
Reference tables are synthetic placeholders with zero clinical validity.
